semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.5.3 Workplace computer
One workplace computer is delivered with your system.
The pictures shown here are only examples. The appearance of your device may be slightly different.
You use this computer to perform the following activities:
Controlling the CT scanner
Evaluating studies
Storing studies
The workplace computer provides several components, for example, USB ports, DVD recorder. The location and the design of these components may vary.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02

3 System description
Do not use the Computer On/Off key. The computer must be switched on and off by using control box and software only.

If you switch off the computer via the Computer On/Off key, it is not able to receive the start-up signal from the control box. In this case, you need to press the Computer On/Off key again to switch on the computer.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 3.5.4 Control box
The control box can be used to control measurements and the patient table.
You can switch on or off the system.
You can start or stop a measurement.
You can move the patient table from outside of the examination room.
You can communicate with the patient from outside of the examination room.

It is within the responsibility of the personnel to make sure that no conflictive table movements or software actions are performed when the control box, the gantry operator panels, or the panel of the i-Control are in use.
A radiation warning lamp lights up and a warning signal sounds when X-radiation is being generated.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Velcro straps for head and body fixation
Cushions
Body support
The body support is an underlay for the mattress. There are different positions for the Velcro strap fixation on both sides of the body support.
Mattress
The mattress provides a comfortable and secure positioning of the pediatric patient on the patient table. It is equipped with flaps.
The flaps secure the body of the pediatric patient. For the positioning of larger patients, use the Velcro straps to fasten the flaps.
Head holder

The head holder is used for the comfortable positioning of the patient's head. Different cushions can be placed inside. For better immobilization, the head holder has Velcro on both sides. Here, you can attach the Velcro straps.
Warning, collision of the patient with the equipment
Indicates possible collision points.
Indicates possible collision of the patient with the gantry. Always watch the patient while the table is moving.
Velcro straps for arm fixation
The Velcro straps for arm fixation secure the arms of the patient. There are various positions for the Velcro straps for arm fixation along the body support on both sides.
Velcro straps for head and body fixation
The Velcro straps secure the head of the patient. For better immobilization, you can attach the Velcro straps to both sides of the head holder.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
3 System description
For the positioning of larger patients, the Velcro straps are used for the fixation of the flaps.
